newsitem.title: USA: Former Astra consultant pleads innocent to fraud charges.
newsitem.headline: Former Astra consultant pleads innocent to fraud charges.

text.p: A former consultant for Astra USA Inc. pleaded innocent Tuesday to charges he conspired with the company's former chief executive to defraud the drug company out of $1 million.

Lars Magnusson, a consultant in 1988 and 1989 and again in 1996, is accused of conspiring with former Astra USA Chief Executive Lars Bildman to defraud the company by instructing contractors to do work for Bildman at company expense, the U.S. attorney's office in Massachusetts said.
Magnusson, 61, owner of Stockholm-based Data Produktion AB, was freed on a $100,000 bond secured by his wife's Auburn, Maine home.

Bildman also pleaded innocent to the charges. He has pleaded innocent to previous charges of fraud, filing false tax statements and travelling across state lines to engage in prostitution previously leveled against him. Astra USA is a unit of Swedish pharmaceutical giant Astra Ab.
